Name: SimPrinter
Author: SimPrinter
Description: Print flight plans and loadsheets from SimPrinter without leaving your Stream Deck. Requires SimPrinter to be running.

Actions.Name: Print Flight Plan
Actions.Tooltip: Prints the flight plan ACARS ticket. Requires a flight plan to be loaded in SimPrinter.

Actions.Name: Print Preliminary Loadsheet
Actions.Tooltip: Prints the preliminary loadsheet. Requires a flight plan to be loaded in SimPrinter.

Actions.Name: Print Final Loadsheet
Actions.Tooltip: Prints the final loadsheet. Requires a flight plan to be loaded in SimPrinter.
